lines.text: Compare first.

The query is compared with every earlier key, and each comparison gives a score. The better the match, the higher the score. The square root in the formula is housekeeping. It just keeps the numbers in range.

lines.text: Then weigh.

A formula called softmax turns those scores into shares that add up to a hundred percent, and the biggest scores take the most. You'd expect "race" and "condition" to get most of what "job" pays attention to, and in the picture they do. Those are the thick lines.
